article.name: How Can I Cancel My 10Web Subscription?
article.title: How Can I Cancel My 10Web Subscription?
article.body:
While we would love for you to stay, we understand if you've decided that 10Web isn't the right fit for you. To cancel your subscription, please follow these steps:

  1. Click the workspace dropdown menu at the top left of your dashboard.
  2. Click Subscription Plans.
  3. You will be redirected to the subscription page, where you can view the details of your current plan.
  4. To cancel your subscription, use the button click here. 
  5. Choose the reason for cancellation and click Submit & Cancel.

Please, note that only the Workspace Owner has access to cancel the subscription.
